sourceDiff: BillingSettings keeps page/dialog presentation; new billingFlow owns selected hosted-flow eligibility, current reads and exact hosted origin validation. Fixed operation registry, backend contracts and shared action lifetime remain unchanged.

independentBrowserRuns.meaning: Fresh403 no dispatch; organization replacement during held preflight no old POST; existing canceled subscription portal-only.

Independent execution of all author regression controls, including6 subscriber statuses,2 new-subscription statuses, unavailable/contradictory reads, stale dialogs, wrong-flow origins, double dispatch and authority replacement.

behaviorReview: Existing hasSubscription true uses portal only when current enabled reads agree; none/trialing without subscription can explicitly start a new subscription. Unsupported/contradictory states remain unavailable.

Fresh state and summary requests precede both hosted actions. Failed or changed eligibility never falls back to another write. Stale eligibility closes dialogs and reloads; transient read failure retains the checkout draft without dispatch.
The exact action-specific HTTPS origin is checked after the canonical URL safety guard. Credentials, unsafe hosts and cross-flow URLs are not accepted.
Existing useSettingsAction provides the synchronous single-action guard and abort/session lifecycle; independent controls show no old POST or redirected old receipt after replacement.

Copy accurately offers review of available plan changes in the hosted portal and describes checkout as a new subscription. It does not guarantee provider configuration, exact invoicing, native capacity change or completed payment.

architecture.reason: BillingSettings remains one screen presentation with checkout/cancel local dialog state. The 292-nonblank signal is principally cohesive JSX for this same billing screen. Flow choice, fresh-read preflight and exact hosted redirect validation are separated into the small billingFlow owner, while the existing typed registry owns transport contracts and useSettingsAction owns cancellation/concurrency. No billing server logic, authority implementation, second catalog, unrelated domain or cyclic dependency was added. Further splitting for line count alone is not needed.

limitations: Root must record exact architecture fingerprint and run combined qualification on the integrated successor.

No native billing-admin authorization, provider URL/session execution, real subscription/capacity/payment/invoice effect or deployed-image acceptance performed. All hosted navigation was fulfilled by synthetic documents.

Frontend preflight cannot provide atomic service-side subscription eligibility; current native URL-only receipt cannot prove tenant/subscription identity beyond the configured trusted operation and host.
Existing hosted cancellation semantics and absent in-app billing contracts remain outside this repair.
